name: Ritsu
source:
Side character of episode 2
One of the three remaining survivors of Futagami village.
[url=/c92664]Mikoto[/url]'s friend. A mature man with a calming mindset.
Later on in the story, [spoiler]Ritsu became the last person living with [url=/c92657]Kirina[/url]. Acknowledging the fact that his sickness would lead to inevitable death, he decided to pass on his daily life experience and skillsets to her before he died.[/spoiler]
